findings.title: Keep the registered metric-alert handler concrete
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler remains registered as MetricAlertFire.detector_handler, but it now inherits four abstract members without implementing them: counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. Accessing detector.detector_handler for a metric_alert_fire detector therefore raises TypeError when the model instantiates this class. process_detectors does not catch that exception, so processing aborts instead of retaining the previous no-op behavior. Keep the handler concrete or leave it unregistered until its required methods are implemented.

findings.title: Use the evaluated group key in the expected occurrence
findings.body: TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe builds its expected occurrence with group key "val1", but calls evaluate_group_key_value with "group_key". The new hook consequently builds an actual occurrence whose fingerprint is ["<detector_id>:group_key"], while the expected fingerprint is ["<detector_id>:val1"]. The DetectorEvaluationResult equality assertion fails even when the implementation behaves correctly. Build the expected occurrence using "group_key".
